task: What guidance did Nike give for the current quarter on its most recent earnings call, and how did the stock react?

c1.note: Release states conference call at 2pm PT on Oct 1, 2026 for FQ1 FY27; no later call before Nov 10.

c3.note: Transcript: the two items represent a headwind of approximately 400 bps to Q2 revenues.

c4.note: The 400 bps headwind was the only Q2-specific item; CFO declined further Q2 revenue/gross margin specifics.

c5.note: CFO said growth rates would be pressured in Q2 sequentially due to tough comparisons.

c6.note: Release outlook covers only full-year FY27; no standalone Q2 forecast given.

c8.note: Denton: 'we're probably not going to provide guidance specifically for gross margin.'

c12.note: CFO said Q2 growth rates pressured by comps; gross margin has puts and takes with discounting pressure.

c13.note: EBIT-greater-than-revenue decline and SG&A down were full-year outlook, not Q2-specific.

c14.note: Release: 'Revenues are expected to decline high-single digits in fiscal 2027.'

c15.note: CFO: 'We currently expect EBIT to decline by a greater percentage than revenue.'

c18.note: Press release states adjusted diluted EPS $1.15-$1.35 excluding ~$0.15 Pace restructuring.

c19.note: Release says tax rate mid-20 percent range; Q1 22.7% per Stocktitan.

c20.note: Derived arithmetic ($1.15-0.15 to $1.35-0.15) matches Stocktitan's roughly $1.00-$1.20.

c21.note: Consistent with Nike starting full-year outlook on this call; Denton's framing matches, though exact quote not in passages.

c24.note: Management said China actions will weigh more than in Q1 and pain through balance of year.

c25.note: Denton: pain through balance of year and bleeding into fiscal '28 for Sportswear, Jordan, China.

c26.note: Midpoint 22% below $1.61 consensus; top of range below every estimate.

c28.note: Stocktitan states close $35.10, down 0.85%, lowest since Nov 2021 peak.

c29.note: Exact after-hours figures stated via Nasdaq quotes.

c30.note: CNBC: shares fell roughly 3% in extended trading Thursday.

c31.note: StockTitan says shares fell as much as 6.6% after hours; sales miss and EPS beat confirmed.

c32.note: Investing.com summary states 6.24% after-hours drop to $32.96.

c33.note: Reuters says shares fell 8.5% in extended trading; this differs from other after-hours figures, which reflect different times.

c34.note: Tiger reports an 8.19% overnight drop to $32.10, which is overnight trading and differs from the regular-session close.

c35.note: Oct 1 closed down 0.85% and Oct 2 fell further, so two straight declines.

c36.note: RTTNews intraday figures match exactly; prior close of $35.15 differs slightly from the $35.10 in other sources.

c37.note: The intraday range and the 57.6M volume match the passage; it was a snapshot, not the full session.

c38.note: CNBC reports shares tumbling on Oct 2 after the weak outlook and layoffs; the ~6% is plausible for the morning, though the passage does not show the exact figure.

c39.note: Yahoo/Trefis states a 3.6% fall on Oct 2 versus S&P 500 +0.7%.

c41.note: Nike's release confirms $11.2B, down 4% reported and 5% currency-neutral; the miss was about $107–140M depending on source.

c42.note: Revenue of $11.21B, down 4%, versus the $11.32B LSEG estimate.

c43.note: Release confirms EPS of $0.48 and net income of $0.7B, down 2%; the beat was $0.04–0.05 depending on source.

c44.note: LSEG consensus of $0.43 versus actual $0.48; other sources cite $0.44.

c45.note: Release states gross margin expanded 60 bps to 42.8%.

c46.note: Transcript states Greater China declined 26% (currency-neutral) in Q1 FY27; reported was -22%.

c48.note: Transcript confirms Sportswear down low double digits, Dunk cut nearly 50%, ~$200M headwind, Performance up high single digits; Jordan mid-teens is not shown in passages but is plausible.

c49.note: Release states ~$2.5B savings through FY2031 and ~$0.3B charges in FY2027; layoffs from 2027 per CNBC.

c50.note: Hill said on the June call that Investor Day will be Nov 16-17 to share the next phase of growth strategy; upcoming as of today.

c51.note: Stock Titan states six-report next-session moves ranged from -15.5% (April 2026) to +15.2% (June 2025), based on Nasdaq closes.

c11.note: StockTitan says the Q1 FY27 release had no Q2 forecast. On the call Nike only gave a ~400bp Q2 revenue headwind, and an analyst noted there was no full Q2 guidance.

c13.note: Misattributed. In the transcript, the outlook for EBIT to fall by a greater percentage than revenue, with SG&A down YoY, covers full fiscal 2027, not Q2. The only Q2-specific guidance was the ~400bp revenue headwind.

c22.note: Denton: 'beginning today, we intend to provide a view of our expectations for the full fiscal year and update that perspective as the year progresses.' He didn't say 'rather than quarter-by-quarter' outright, but it's implied.

c34.note: The Tiger Brokers article does say Nike fell 8.19% overnight to $32.10 on Oct 2. Other outlets reported smaller moves (e.g. -6.6% after hours), and $32.10 doesn't quite match an 8.19% drop from StockTitan's $35.10 pre-release close. The claim is only that Tiger reported it, which is accurate.

c50.note: StockTitan and the Q1 call (Investor Day 'in November') support Nov 16-17, 2026, and it's still upcoming as of Nov 10. I found no official Nike press release confirming the dates and no report of a postponement.
